rows.proof: THE GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS, FISCAL YEAR 2016, pages 25-30 of the FY2016 annual town report. PROGRAM NAME | APPROPRIATED FORWARD | TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE | TOTAL EXPENDED | TOTAL ENCUMBERED | BALANCE TO REVENUE. WHAT CLOSES. TOTAL ENCUMBERED sums to the printed GRAND TOTAL $637,981.43 TO THE CENT over the 79 unit rows. Every unit's membership was resolved by the PAGE'S OWN ARITHMETIC rather than by eye: a subtotal row claims the shortest run of preceding rows that sums to it in every column it prints, and it refused on no page. Total Insurance $1,919,998.72 foots its five members exactly; the unlabelled STATE & COUNTY ASSESSMENTS subtotal $1,303,195.00 foots its eight printed members exactly. COVERAGE: every money token the text layer holds on each page is placed in a column -- 171/171, 118/118, 123/123, 98/98, 123/123, 102/102 for pages 25-30. FY2016 IS BORN-DIGITAL: pdfplumber returns 99-628 words on every page of this run and the pages carry no embedded image, so no recognition was used and none should be. THREE ROWS ARE IN THE FILE AND ARE NOT DRAWN. Page 28 carries a `Town Barn Maintenance` group (Other Expenses $1,503.62, subtotal $1,503.62/$1,503.62/$1,503.62/$0.00) and the Vehicle Maintenance subtotal ($141,026.85/$141,026.85/$128,185.55/$430.37/$12,410.93); page 30 carries `County Retirement Assessment $967,652.00` at top=345.53, overprinted on the `STATE & COUNTY ASSESSMENTS` heading at top=342.92 (Arial,Bold 8.2 against Arial,BoldItalic 8.5). render_pdf_page.swift draws NONE of the three. The two page-28 rows are required by the GRAND TOTAL -- including them takes the BALANCE TO REVENUE residual from -$15,248.01 to -$2,837.08, and only then does the residual satisfy the page's own row identity -- so they are transcribed. County Retirement is EXCLUDED from the printed $1,303,195.00 subtotal (the eight drawn rows foot it exactly) and whether the GRAND TOTAL includes it is NOT ESTABLISHED; it is transcribed as a unit and this is said here so nobody reads it as settled. WHAT IS ATTESTED, AND WHY IT IS THE TOWN'S. Four columns do not reach the printed GRAND TOTAL, and the shortfall is ONE missing unit, not a reading: TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE is short $3,757,764.38 (after the Veteran's Benefits typo below), TOTAL EXPENDED short $3,754,927.30, TOTAL ENCUMBERED short $0.00 and BALANCE TO REVENUE short $2,837.08 -- and 3,757,764.38 - 3,754,927.30 - 0.00 = 2,837.08 EXACTLY, which is the identity the page states about every one of its rows. A misreading cannot satisfy that. WHAT THE SCHEDULE OMITS: it prints Interest Serial Loans, Interest Temporary Loans and Loan Administrative Fees and NO PRINCIPAL ROW. The FY16 OMNIBUS BUDGET printed in the same report, page 174, line 1, prints `Principal-Loans $2,876,260.00`, and the FY2017 report's schedule prints a `DEBT AND INTEREST` section whose first leaf is `Principal Serial Loans $3,097,672.00`. WHAT THIS DOES NOT SHOW: that the omitted unit IS the principal line, or that it is a single line. $2,876,260.00 is the VOTED figure and $3,757,764.38 is what the GRAND TOTAL requires; nothing here reconciles the two, and the omitted row's label is not printed anywhere in the document. A SECOND TOWN ERROR, page 29: `Veteran's Benefits` prints APPROPRIATED FORWARD $100,000.00 and TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE $1,000,000.00 -- an extra zero. Its own row closes on the smaller figure: expended $85,368.80 + balance $14,631.20 = $100,000.00. Both figures are read off the born-digital text layer and confirmed on the 4x render, so neither is a misread. The $1,000,000.00 is transcribed as printed and the row is attested. THE fwd LEGEND DOES NOT CLOSE EITHER: page 30 prints `fwd - forward from FY 2015 $265,386.55` and the 15 fwd lines the run prints sum to $259,894.72, out by $5,491.83. Registered, not reconciled.
